description: This file contains embedded C code for an STM32F4 microcontroller, implementing SPI and UART communication, GPIO pin configurations, and main control loop for handling data transfer and LED indicators.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes hardware peripherals (clocks, GPIOs, SPI, UART), then enters an infinite loop performing SPI transactions and toggling GPIOs for signaling.

methods.name: spi
methods.description: Handles data transmission over SPI interface, managing chip select line and collecting response.

methods.name: uart_putc
methods.description: Transmits a character over UART, managing transmit buffer and enabling transmit interrupt.

methods.name: uart_getc
methods.description: Retrieves a character from the UART receive buffer if available.

methods.name: USART3_IRQHandler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for UART3, manages reception and transmission buffers for incoming and outgoing data.
